title: Adventure Playsets Recall to Repair Backyard Swing Sets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic-coated lumber on the horizontal ladder (monkey bar/swing beam) can weaken over time due to rotting of the whitewood (spruce, pine and fir species), resulting in a fall hazard. Units: About 275,000 in the United States and 6,800 in Canada.

title: Children's Art Easels Recalled by MacPherson's Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The chalkboard surface coating contains high levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Samsung Over-the-Range Microwaves Recalled Due to Shock Hazard
summary: If an installation bolt comes in contact with an electrical component inside the unit and the microwave is plugged into an ungrounded outlet, it could create a shock hazard. Units: About 43,000.

title: The Life is Good Company Travel Mugs Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The travel mugs can become excessively hot to the touch when filled with hot liquids, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 15,000.

title: Salomon USA Recalls Ski Bindings Due to Unexpected Release, Fall Hazard
summary: The toe component of the ski bindings could fail to fully secure the ski boot to the ski binding, causing the binding to release unexpectedly. This could cause the skier to lose control or fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 10,000.

title: Stainless Steel Cookware Recalled by Cost Plus World Market Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The handles on the cookware can break, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 300.

title: Baby Hammocks Recalled by Three Sisters Toys Due to Fall and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The hammock can flip over, posing a serious fall hazard and strangulation hazard to infants who become entrapped in the seat's restraint straps while upside down. Units: About 20.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts and Jackets Recalled by Century 21 Promotions, Inc. Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 17,000.

title: Fire and Burn Hazards Prompt Recall of Gas Grills Sold at Lowe's Stores
summary: The burners can deteriorate causing irregular flames and the lids of some models can catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards to the consumer. Units: About 663,000 in the United States and about 1,700 in Canada.

title: Gorilla Inc. Recalls EXO-Tech Safety Harness Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The webbing of the waist belt on the safety harness is not routed through the lineman's loop located on the front of the harness near waist level. Since the loops are not properly anchored to the harness webbing but are attached only through stitching not intended to restrain a user during a fall, t

title: Grand World Recalls "Bobby Chupete" Pacifiers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifiers fail to meet federal safety standards. The pacifier mouth guard is too small, posing a choking hazard to infants and toddlers. Units: About 641,000.

title: Backpack Blowers Recalled by Homelite Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank can leak gasoline, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 85,000.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Easton Sports; Stem Failure Poses Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls. Units: About 6,400.

title: Treestands Recalled by Gander Mountain Company Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The clasp may open unexpectedly if the strap is fastened incorrectly, causing the treestand and user to fall to the ground. Units: About 13,000.

title: Gehl Foods Recalls Nacho Cheese and Chili Sauce Dispensers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The dispenser's fan blade can come into contact with the heater coil, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 115,000.

title: Power Adapters Used with IBM RDX Back Up Disk Hard Drives Recalled Due to Shock Hazard
summary: A plastic weld on the power adapters can fail and allow two parts to separate, exposing live electrical contacts. This poses a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 90.

title: Maclaren USA Recalls to Repair Strollers Following Fingertip Amputations
summary: The stroller's hinge mechanism poses a fingertip amputation and laceration hazard to the child when the consumer is unfolding/opening the stroller. Units: About one million.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Allura Imports Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 3,700.

title: Team Work Trading Expands Recall of Children's Metal Pendants Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled children's pendants contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 1,500 (This recall was first announced in Sept. 2009).

title: Boy's Warm-up Sets Recalled by Fashion Options Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have drawstrings through the hoods, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 5,400.

title: Electrolux ICON and Kenmore PRO Gas Ranges Recalled Due to Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: An incorrect part allows more fuel to pass to the range's oven than can be burned efficiently, causing incomplete combustion and the release of carbon monoxide. This poses a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning to consumers. Units: About 900.

title: Infant Entrapment and Suffocation Prompts Stork Craft to Recall More Than 2.1 Million Drop-Side Cribs
summary: The cribs' drop-side plastic hardware can break, deform, or parts can become missing. In addition, the drop-side can be installed upside-down, which can result in broken or disengaged plastic parts. All of these problems can cause the drop-side to detach in one or more corners.
